UnitStatement: core/rules/rule_pack_lifecycle records metadata and reproducibility evidence for user-owned rule packs; it does not store private payloads, parse/canonicalize JSON, implement encryption/access control, expose private formulas, or make professional/code-compliance claims.

GRAMMAR_VERSION_PAYLOAD_KEY = "grammar_version": the JSON member key binding the expression grammar version inside the JCS-canonicalized rule-pack payload bytes hashed by rule_pack_checksum (DEC-022).
Because the grammar_version member sits inside the hashed bytes, the reported checksum (FR-016) changes whenever the declared grammar version changes.

grammar_version_jcs_member(version) returns the exact JCS encoding of the grammar-version member ("grammar_version":"<version>"); JCS emits sorted keys with no insignificant whitespace, so this byte sequence must appear verbatim in any JCS payload declaring the version at an object boundary.

payload_declares_grammar_version(canonical_payload, grammar_version) is a byte-containment check for the exact JCS member encoding; since the crate does not parse JSON it is a necessary-condition check, and absence is conclusive that the payload cannot bind the declared grammar version.

is_semver_grammar_version(version) enforces strict MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH: three dot-separated decimal components, no signs, no leading zeros, no pre-release/build suffixes; it mirrors the evaluator-side rule in core/rules/expression_evaluator.

The Pipe Section Property Calculator (DEL-03-08) implements bounded pipe section and mass-property calculations from user-entered dimensions and densities.

The section calculator is intentionally narrow: it accepts already-parsed values (not external catalog formats), provides no schedule/dimensional/material/component defaults, does not convert units until the project unit catalog is accepted, records blocking diagnostics for missing/non-positive/incompatible inputs, and marks calculated values as derived from user-entered data.

For circular pipe sections the calculator derives effective inside diameter after corrosion allowance, metal area, second moment of area, elastic section modulus, polar/torsional constant, contents volume per length, and metal/contents/insulation/total mass per length when matching density inputs are provided.

Inputs remain user-supplied; public fixtures and schemas must not use this module to smuggle protected dimensional tables, proprietary catalog values, code-specific allowables, SIFs, flexibility factors, or private project data into the repository.

core/section_properties/calculator.py computes pipe section and mass properties from user-entered values; it provides no dimensional tables, material defaults, unit-conversion constants, or catalog lookups, requires explicit compatible unit metadata, and reports diagnostics when inputs are insufficient.
calculator.py constants: LENGTH_DIMENSIONS={"length"}, DENSITY_DIMENSIONS={"density"}, DIAGNOSTIC_SOURCE="core/section_properties/calculator.py".
Quantity is a frozen dataclass with magnitude (float), unit (str), dimension (str), and provenance (dict).
SectionDiagnostic is a frozen dataclass with code, diagnostic_class, severity, field, source, affected_object, message, remediation, provenance.
PipeSectionInput frozen dataclass: outside_diameter and wall_thickness (Quantity|None) plus optional corrosion_allowance, material_density, contents_density, insulation_thickness, insulation_density.
PipeSectionResult frozen dataclass holds properties dict and diagnostics tuple; its accepted property is true when no diagnostic has blocking severity.

calculate_pipe_section_properties computes pipe section properties using explicit compatible units only, validating required and optional quantities and returning early with diagnostics if any are present.
calculate_pipe_section_properties enforces a single shared length unit across outside_diameter, wall_thickness, corrosion_allowance, and insulation_thickness inputs.
calculate_pipe_section_properties enforces a single (optional) density unit across material, contents, and insulation densities.
effective_wall = wall.magnitude - corrosion_value, and inside_diameter = od.magnitude - 2*effective_wall.
The calculator emits SECTION_CALCULATION_INPUT_INVALID when corrosion allowance leaves no positive effective wall, when inside diameter is negative, or when insulation thickness is negative.

Section geometry formulas: metal_area = pi/4*(OD^2 - ID^2); moment_of_inertia = pi/64*(OD^4 - ID^4); section_modulus = I/(OD/2); torsional_constant = pi/32*(OD^4 - ID^4); contents_volume_per_length = pi/4*ID^2.

The properties dict carries inside_diameter, metal_area, cross_section_area, moment_of_inertia (unit length^4), section_modulus (length^3), torsional_constant (length^4), and contents_volume_per_length (length^2) as Quantity values with dimension labels.

Mass-per-length parts are computed only when a density unit is present: metal_mass = metal_area*material_density; contents_mass = contents_volume_per_length*contents_density; insulation_mass = insulation_area*insulation_density.
Insulation outside diameter = OD + 2*insulation_thickness and insulation_area = pi/4*(insulation_OD^2 - OD^2).
When mass parts exist, each is given unit density_unit*length^2 with dimension mass_per_length and a total mass_per_length is added as their sum.

quantity_from_mapping builds a Quantity from schema-like value metadata (unit/unit_ref, dimension/dimension_id, magnitude, provenance), returning None if it is not a dict or any required field is missing.
_require_quantity emits SECTION_DIMENSION_MISSING for a None required field, otherwise validates the quantity.
_optional_quantity returns None for absent optional fields, otherwise validates the quantity.

_validate_quantity emits SECTION_UNIT_MISSING (empty unit/dimension), SECTION_PROVENANCE_MISSING (no provenance), SECTION_DIMENSION_INCONSISTENT (dimension not in expected), and SECTION_CALCULATION_INPUT_INVALID for non-positive or negative values (corrosion_allowance and insulation_thickness exempt from the positive check).

_single_unit returns the shared unit of present quantities, emitting SECTION_DIMENSION_INCONSISTENT for mismatched units (the calculator does not convert units in this deliverable) and SECTION_UNIT_MISSING when a required unit is empty.

_quantity builds a derived Quantity with provenance attributing the OpenPipeStress section property calculator, project_source license, certification 'calculated from user-entered dimensions; no catalog value supplied', redistribution derived_from_user_input, review_status calculated.
_blocking constructs a SectionDiagnostic with diagnostic_class SOLVE_BLOCKING, severity blocking, the calculator DIAGNOSTIC_SOURCE, and calculator provenance.

PUBLIC_SHARED_CONTEXTS are public_repository, public_example, public_fixture, public_report, shared_model, downstream_tool.
LOCAL_PRIVATE_CONTEXTS are local_private, private_project_package, private_library, private_rule_pack, private_report, private_diagnostic, local_cache.
BLOCKED_REMOTE_CONTEXTS are cloud_storage, cloud_sync, hosted_database, network_share, network_sync, remote_service.
DIRECT_SQL_CONTEXTS are direct_sql, raw_sqlite, sqlite_table_access; STORAGE_CONTEXTS is the union of public-shared, local-private, blocked-remote, and direct-SQL contexts.

SYMBOLIC_STORAGE_CLASSES enumerate the allowed symbolic storage roots (e.g. USER_CHOSEN_PROJECT_PACKAGE, USER_PRIVATE_RULE_PACK_ROOT, LOCAL_CACHE_ROOT, USER_SECRET_REFERENCE) used instead of concrete paths.
PRIVATE_RECORD_KINDS, PUBLIC_RECORD_KINDS, and STORAGE_RECORD_KINDS (their union plus 'unknown') enumerate recognized storage record kinds.
PRIVATE_PRIVACY_CLASSES and PUBLIC_PRIVACY_CLASSES enumerate recognized privacy classifications; UNKNOWN_STATUSES are {unknown, TBD, '', None}.

Status sets: PUBLIC_REDIS_STATUSES (public_permissive, invented_non_engineering_example), PRIVATE_REDIS_STATUSES (private_only), BLOCKING_REVIEW_STATUSES (quarantined, rejected), PROTECTED_STATUSES (protected_suspected).

CONCRETE_PATH_KEYS enumerate concrete-path keys (path, file_path, absolute_path, local_path, db_path, sqlite_path, uri) and CLOUD_NETWORK_KEYS enumerate cloud/network reference keys.

StorageDiagnostic frozen dataclass has code, severity, path, message, remediation and an as_schema_dict serializer.

StorageRecord frozen dataclass carries record identity/kind/label, locality, privacy/redistribution/review status, source state/note, checksum metadata, value_descriptor, and unsafe-detail flags (contains_payload, secret_material_present, concrete_path_present, cloud_or_network_reference, direct_sql_access) plus unresolved_tbd.

StorageDecision frozen dataclass holds decision/record identity, target_context, action, reason_code, metadata_only, default_posture, diagnostics, and metadata; its blocked property is true when action is block_storage or any diagnostic is BLOCKING.

_normalize_storage_record coerces a StorageRecord or mapping into a StorageRecord (raising TypeError otherwise), inferring kind, detecting payload/secret/concrete-path/cloud-network/direct-SQL signals from keys, and withholding source detail when any unsafe detail is present.

Normalization detects unsafe detail via PAYLOAD_KEYS, SECRET_MATERIAL_KEYS, concrete-path heuristics, BLOCKED_REMOTE_CONTEXTS / CLOUD_NETWORK_KEYS, and DIRECT_SQL_CONTEXTS / DIRECT_SQL_KEYS; secret material also requires a payload key when inferred from kind/name.

_classification_diagnostics emits BLOCKING CLOUD_OR_NETWORK_STORAGE_BLOCKED, DIRECT_SQL_ACCESS_BLOCKED, SECRET_MATERIAL_METADATA_ONLY_REQUIRED, and STORAGE_PAYLOAD_METADATA_ONLY_REQUIRED for the corresponding detected detail.
_classification_diagnostics emits CONCRETE_PATH_REDUCED_TO_SAFE_METADATA (WARNING) when concrete path detail was detected and withheld.
_classification_diagnostics emits BLOCKING PUBLIC_REPOSITORY_PRIVATE_STORAGE_BLOCKED when private storage metadata targets PUBLIC_REPOSITORY_CONTENT.
_classification_diagnostics emits WARNINGs REDISTRIBUTION_STATUS_UNRESOLVED, PRIVACY_CLASSIFICATION_UNRESOLVED, and SOURCE_STATE_UNRESOLVED for unknown statuses.
_classification_diagnostics emits BLOCKING REVIEW_DISPOSITION_BLOCKED for quarantined/rejected review and PROTECTED_SOURCE_SUSPECTED for protected-suspected redistribution or review.

_guard_record gathers classification diagnostics, computes (action, reason) via _guard_action, appends a diagnostic for the reason if absent, and returns a StorageDecision with a stable LFS-GRD id and safe manifest metadata.

_guard_action blocks remote (CLOUD_OR_NETWORK_CONTEXT_BLOCKED) and direct-SQL (DIRECT_SQL_CONTEXT_BLOCKED) target contexts, and blocks records carrying cloud/network, direct-SQL, secret, payload, blocking-review, or protected-suspected detail.
For PUBLIC_SHARED_CONTEXTS, _guard_action blocks concrete paths, private records, unknown privacy, and unknown redistribution, else allows SAFE_PUBLIC_METADATA.

For LOCAL_PRIVATE_CONTEXTS, _guard_action requires explicit user intent for private records (LOCAL_PRIVATE_INTENT_REQUIRED), reduces concrete paths to safe metadata, allows private local metadata, and otherwise allows safe public metadata; unsupported contexts return UNSUPPORTED_STORAGE_CONTEXT.

_safe_manifest_metadata withholds concrete-path, cloud/network, direct-SQL, secret, and payload detail in the manifest, and for private records in public/shared contexts also withholds checksum and private detail.

_classification_reason returns the first blocking diagnostic code if blocking, else PRIVATE_METADATA_LOCAL_FIRST for private records, SAFE_PUBLIC_METADATA for public privacy classes, else REVIEW_REQUIRED.

_default_posture returns blocked_until_metadata_only_local_first if blocking, local_private_metadata_requires_explicit_intent for private records, public_metadata_allowed for public privacy classes, else review_required.
_diagnostic constructs a StorageDiagnostic from code, severity, path, message, and remediation.
_message_for_reason and _remediation_for_reason map each reason code to its human-readable message and remediation text.
_severity_for_action returns BLOCKING for block_storage and WARNING otherwise; _has_blocking is true if any diagnostic is BLOCKING.
_storage_kind normalizes a record kind via an alias map (e.g. rule/rule_pack->private_rule_pack, secret/credential->secret_reference, public->public_metadata).
_privacy_for_kind maps each storage kind to its default privacy classification (e.g. private_rule_pack->private_rule_pack_data, secret_reference->secret_like_data, public kinds->public_metadata).

_storage_locality_for_kind maps each kind to its default symbolic storage root (e.g. private_rule_pack->USER_PRIVATE_RULE_PACK_ROOT, secret_reference->USER_SECRET_REFERENCE, public_metadata->PUBLIC_REPOSITORY_CONTENT).

_infer_record_kind infers a kind from record id/label/name text using secret-name markers and keyword matches (rule, material, component, report, diagnostic, cache, project/model), else returns the fallback.
_is_private returns true when the record kind, privacy classification, redistribution status, or storage locality indicates private/user storage.
_looks_secret_like returns true when the kind is secret_reference or the record's identifying text contains a secret name marker.
_looks_concrete_path returns false for unknown/symbolic/USER_/PUBLIC_/LOCAL_CACHE_ROOT values and true when the text contains '/', '\\', ':', or 'FAKE_CONCRETE'.
_unresolved_items returns the names of supplied values that fall in UNKNOWN_STATUSES.
_stable_id builds a deterministic id by sha256-hashing canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators) of the payload and taking the first 16 hex chars with a prefix.
_string returns a default for None/empty, the value for non-empty strings, else str(value); _optional_string returns None for None else str; _tuple_strings normalizes a value into a tuple of strings.
